column1: # One row per governed live surface. Bounded TSV, parsed with awk: no interpreter enters the commit
# path. Columns are positional; `-' means "not applicable to this kind of surface".
#   * health_*  = the reviewed steady-state working set; the denominator for the 80% warning.
#   * ceil_*    = the INCLUSIVE enforcement ceiling: actual > ceiling fails, equality passes.
#   * a ceiling rises only by a recorded authority (a decision record cited in `notes`), never to
#   * debt      = the exact measured baseline at adoption for an axis already past its health target,
#     plus the leaf that owns bringing it down. A baseline never widens.
#   * meas_*    = the measurement at adoption; re-derived by scripts/check_live_doc_size.sh (SPINE.4.3).
# GLOB SEMANTICS (measured, because they differ from shell globs): `path_or_glob` is expanded with
#   `git ls-files -- <glob>`, whose `*` crosses `/`. So `docs/book/src/*.md` matches nested chapters
#   too, while `docs/book/src/**/*.md` matches ONLY nested ones and silently misses top-level files.
#   A `;`-separated list (kind=list) names exact paths. The checker refuses a glob that matches
#   nothing unless the row declares meas_files=0 (a destination that does not exist yet).
# Derivation notes that are not per-row: per-part health for a collection is derived from the SHAPE of
# its content (a gate tree with ~15 leaves x leaf block + evidence section; a decision record with
# context/decision/consequences; a book chapter), never from today's largest file. Doctrine registry
# tables carry long "what it proves" cells, which is why the doctrine_docs maxline health is 700.

column21: line+byte ceilings are the spine's own (scripts/check_memory_architecture.sh); the maxline axis is added here

aggregate follows legitimate product scope, so health is the adoption baseline carried as debt (not a target); the baseline is REVISION-AWARE — `at=v0.3` is the revision it was measured at, re-based by the §11 G3 envelope-coverage amendment logged in the roadmap's Appendix A under the director's delegation (defect D32), and the checker refuses a baseline whose revision the file no longer declares, so growth needs a revision and a revision needs its log entry. The missing section index and per-section bounds are owned by SPINE.13; decision_revision-aware-containment-baseline.md

window bounded by rollover: the oldest entries are sealed into docs/history/stitchcad-changelog-part1.md (sha256 recorded there) whenever the live window passes its health target; the append that crosses the milestone performs the rollover
lessons are promoted to layer C by the LESSON-PROMOTION gate, which is the real containment; overflow destination docs/history/
single latest entry by design; history is git's
freshness is proved by the KNOWLEDGE-MAP doctrine (regenerated and staged by the hook); holds no unique facts
the book's mandatory index; grows one line per chapter
the one hand-curated input to the derived map

per-part limits derived from the largest adopted standard (MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE.md at 455 lines / 24573 bytes) plus ~15% headroom for a local adoption note: adopted texts are fixed by their source, so the honest target is the document plus a note, not a round number. The widest line is DOCTRINE_ENFORCEMENT.md's 658-byte registry row (a NEUTRAL file, not edited locally)

per-part health 800 lines is derived from the SHAPE of a tree file (a gate tree with ~15 leaves x leaf block + evidence section), not from today's largest file. SPINE.md is above it during its own build-out; the remediation is a convention, not a bigger number: each leaf keeps its evidence to the six boxes with tight bullets, and a tree that passes 1000 lines splits its completed-leaf evidence into a sibling file under docs/tasks/ before adding more MAXLINE DERIVED FROM THE CELL BUDGET (SPINE.15): the binding shape is the verification log's `Date｜Leaf｜Checks｜Result` row (52 rows, 4 columns), per-column p95 cells 430 B plus 13 B of separator = 443 B, which is also the widest line any tree file carries; re-derive with run_cell_budget_census.sh over 'docs/tasks/*.md'. Four rows above it were tightened rather than the target raised to fit them.

one record per decision; the maxline health is DERIVED from the binding shape's cell budget (SPINE.15): the index's `Record｜Type｜One-line hook` row, 17 rows, per-column p95 cells summing to 372 B plus 10 B of separator = 382 B, re-derived by docs/tasks/artifacts/live_doc_size/run_cell_budget_census.sh with CELL_BUDGET_GLOB='docs/decisions/*.md'. The old `maxline=491` debt is cleared: the row that carried it became bounded prose (the house remedy) and the nine index hooks that had grown into three-line summaries are one line each again

the public documentation surface; aggregate follows product scope while per-part limits bind. SUMMARY.md is counted here and additionally bounded by the book_summary row. MAXLINE DERIVED FROM THE CELL BUDGET OF THE BINDING SHAPE, not from prose (SPINE.4.4): the glossary termbase (5 columns, 276 rows) has per-column p95 cells summing to 259 B plus 16 B of separator (3 x columns + 1) = 275 B health, and a max-sum of 379 B, so the ceiling is 440 B = 1.6 x health, the ratio every other row uses; the old 320 B was below the shape's own worst legitimate row. Re-derive with docs/tasks/artifacts/live_doc_size/run_cell_budget_census.sh (widest line at the derivation: 272 B = 99% of health, so the warning now means AT BUDGET and its remedy is SPINE.15's table-authoring convention). decision_maxline-health-derived-from-the-cell-budget.md

sealed segments are immutable and carry their identity (lines/bytes/sha256) in their own header; two segments sealed so far (bedrock scaffold history by SPINE.14, changelog slices 1-15 by G0-CONTRACT.18)
